From OpenClaw

Bring an agent over.

Archie reads the agent’s folder on your computer and shows what it would make before making anything. Free at 20 jobs a day on your own AI account.

Bringing it over sends nothing anywhere and changes nothing of OpenClaw’s, and none of OpenClaw’s keys or passwords come over. You do not have to switch anything.

Download Archie See what comes over

In beta on Mac and Windows.

What comes over

Personality, notes, skills and jobs.

Comes over

  • Its personality, from SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md and, if ticked, AGENTS.md
  • What it knows about you, from USER.md
  • Its notes. The newest into memory, the rest into older memory it checks when you mention them
  • Its skills, plus OpenClaw’s shared skills you keep ticked
  • Its scheduled jobs, as Archie routines

Stays behind, with reasons shown

  • OpenClaw’s keys and passwords. Connect your AI account and chat app in Archie
  • Its chat apps, tools and plugins
  • A skill that needs a program, and a job that runs one
  • A job whose schedule a routine cannot match exactly, like more than 24 runs a day

Notes and skills come over word for word, anything you wrote in them included. Read them on the review screen first.

How it goes

Install, press New agent, review.

1. Install Archie first

The free version has one agent, so bring OpenClaw’s over before you use it: it takes that agent’s place, and the screen says so first.

2. Bring one over from OpenClaw

Press New agent in the sidebar, then Bring one over from OpenClaw. Archie looks in .openclaw, or you pick the folder.

3. Read the review, then press

It shows the new agent and what stays behind, with reasons.

Routines run on your AI account as often as they did in OpenClaw. The review flags anything hourly or faster; change or switch off any routine later.

After the move

Replies and calendar moves wait for you.

A reply goes out only when you send it or set a time, and no setting turns that off. Your words go to your chosen AI company by default.
